title: A container lost BETWEEN tool rounds needs a host-side ready check
body:
The env detects a lost container only where it can see a loss signal: the tracked bash's poll (process missing/lost) and a replay's fresh start. A container destroyed between rounds, under a file operation, boots empty and the next read/write fails plainly (ENOENT) rather than restoring, so the model sees missing files instead of a restored workspace. The run-door RPC has no loss observable, so the check belongs to the WorkerAgent host (epic step 6), which owns the container's lifetime and can verify a ready marker before a round (or call the public FactorySandboxEnv.restoreLostWorkspace()).
evidence: harness/src/workspace/checkpoints.ts (module doc, 'Known boundary'); harness/src/env/factory-sandbox.ts containerLost/ensureWorkspaceRestored are the two covered paths
